# Sumit Sain – Full Stack Developer & WordPress Expert

## Who I Am

Sumit Sain is a Full Stack Developer and WordPress Expert based in Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, India. He is currently working at ZENVIQ Digital Agency (https://zenviqdigital.in) and pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Maharaja Ganga Singh University, Bikaner.

He specialises in building fast, SEO-friendly, and responsive websites for businesses, founders, and individuals across India and worldwide.

## Services

- Custom Next.js & React web applications
- WordPress website development and customisation
- Full stack web development (frontend + backend)
- UI/UX implementation and design systems
- Website performance optimisation and SEO

## Tech Stack
